scope: Local source, exhaustive schema/route tests, client typechecks, complete Chromium workflows, strict static checks, policy validators, and production-build evidence for every browser-facing read mode on /api/recon. Synthetic identifiers, tokens, credentials, diagnostics, financial values, and evidence only. No customer data, provider system, protected ingress, staging deployment, compliance, or production-readiness claim is included.

fixedBrowserMetadata: exception queue filtered count, export permission, summary, and optional cursor
removedApiOnlyExamples: organization membership identifiers not used by the browser selector
upstream correlation, truncation, and maximum-item metadata not used by the view
connector credential creator, rotation, update, and internal reference fields
invitation creator, accepting-user, accepting-membership, and update fields
CSV template, mapping, validity, and internal failure fields not used by the history view
unknown root, item, and declared nested-object fields
rejectedOrDiscardedConditions: invalid identifier, hash, timestamp, money, currency, status, role, or cursor
view-specific list or page above its ceiling
declared or streamed selected-tenant success body above 5 MiB
unknown or status-mismatched internal API error
declared or streamed internal API error body above 64 KiB
successful response fields not named by the selected view contract

focusedGate.command: pnpm exec vitest run apps/web/src/tenant-read-response.test.ts apps/web/src/app/api/recon/route.test.ts apps/web/src/upstream-api-error.test.ts

knownLimitations: Named deterministic evidence, record-reference, normalized-value, and policy-snapshot fields remain intentionally browser-visible JSON; the BFF validates their presence and total size but the API remains responsible for minimizing their contents.
This local proof does not exercise a compromised web process, protected ingress, network fault, deployment proxy, or production internal API.
The view and error policies must be updated deliberately when a new read mode, browser field, or browser-actionable internal API error is introduced; unknown contract drift fails closed.
The 5 MiB selected-tenant ceiling is a transport maximum across materially different evidence views, not a claim that every view requires or should routinely approach that size.
This increment does not migrate the openid-client dependency path, close provider sandbox or release-integrity findings, or satisfy protected-staging evidence.
One local workstation run is not CI, staging, reliability, capacity, compliance, or production-readiness evidence.
conclusion: All 18 browser-facing read modes on /api/recon now use bounded, validated, minimized successful-response contracts and fixed error treatment. This closes BFF-READ-RESPONSE-001 locally without expanding tenant, financial, provider, source-system, or AI authority. Goal 1 remains active; API evidence-content review plus provider, owner, distributed-runtime, and protected-staging gates remain open.
